description: Desktop-only capability set for the main SecuraCV Lab window. Intentionally EMPTY: the self-update flow (manifest check, native confirm dialog, relaunch) is driven entirely from Rust (self_update.rs), and so are the menu bar companion's tray and notifications (companion.rs) — the webview capability system gates neither, and the Lab frontend never calls plugin:updater, plugin:dialog, plugin:process or plugin:notification — it uses core.invoke, event and opener only (see default.json). Granting any of them here only widened what an injected script could do. Kept as a file so the desktop/iOS platform split stays visible.
